Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring public notification of industrial development levies by port districts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public notification of industrial developmentlevies by port districts; and adding a new section to chapter 53.36RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 53.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a port district intends to levy a tax under RCW 53.36.100, theport commission must hold a public hearing within twenty days ofpublication of notice of the intention as required in RCW 53.36.100.The port commission must also provide notice of the public hearing inthe official newspaper of record in the county in which the portdistrict is located at least ten days prior to the date of the publichearing. The notice shall clearly state that the port district intendsto levy a tax under RCW 53.36.100, shall contain the date, time, andlocation of the port district meeting at which the levy will beconsidered and voted upon, and must include a statement describing theamount the measure will increase or decrease taxes. For a levyauthorized under RCW 53.36.100(2), the notice must clearly state that p. 1 SSB 6789the public may gather a petition to submit the levy to the voters ofthe port district under the procedures set forth in RCW 53.36.100(2).
